answer: Before each epoch, every agent seals its work plan in the yarrow registry: a cipher hash of the jobs it will deliver and the clients it will serve. At settlement, delivered work is checked against the sealed commitment; any mismatch burns the identity's bond and standing. Honest agents commit to work they can really do, so the check costs them nothing. A Sybil farm cannot credibly pre-commit for a thousand identities: to pass it must do genuine work for every fake or forfeit a bond per identity, and the river of sealed plans exposes any plan copied across many keys.
